entries.title: Integral Bifurcated Landing Stair
entries.description: One newly authored complete grounded T-plan stone stair solid. A central lower approach rises into a full shared landing; two opposed upper flights branch left and right to two separate raised terminals. The material boundary is one closed connected editable mesh with no interior coincident cell faces. Unlike the old single-route straight, quarter-turn and returning parallel flights, its ascent route branches at the landing from one low approach into two upper directions. This is not extra repeated old steps or changed height, colour or tread count. Native metres, horizontal bounds-centred ground sole, two opaque constant PBR materials. One static architecture module, zero scenes. No handrails, supporting upper floor, host wall, pedestrian navigation, accessibility, load, code compliance, installation or safety guarantee.

entries.title: Stepped Outdoor Outcrop Viewpoint
entries.description: One static outdoor photography viewpoint scene from the original outdoor-camera-position program, one scene and zero new independent models. Three whole qualified original assets are preserved: a tripod box camera on a raised stone-like terrace, its open recessed-insert camera bag separately beside it, and a complete fractured natural outcrop on the lower terrain to the right. Only the complete camera turns exactly 90 degrees toward the outcrop; all old meshes, raw GLB geometry, normals, internal nodes and full per-face PBR remain unchanged at unit scale. A single continuous scene-only ground solid provides the raised camera and bag terrace, three intermediate descent treads and broad lower rock bed. Complete finite original feet and bag bottom sit within the upper horizontal terrace; the complete rock sole is on the lower bed. This is an outdoor high-low camera position with an actual whole terrain subject, not a rearranged portrait backdrop or still-life tabletop set. The bag remains empty; neither camera nor lens is inserted into its recesses. No optical targeting accuracy, camera image capture, weather protection, adjustable camera mount, path clearance certification, pedestrian accessibility, safe footing, structural strength or safety suitability is claimed.
